messages:
Noah Simms: Hi everyone  Im Noah, starting today on Product Platform. Remote, EST. Quick list: laptop/MDM, VPN/GitHub, and who to ping for infra sandbox access? Also tiny fun fact: Im a terrible ukulele player but I bring it to team retreats :uke:  

Alyssa Chen: Welcome Noah!! :tada: Im your onboarding buddy. Ill send a quick intro calendar for 20m. For access: Alex handles hardware/MDM, Ben handles infra/sandbox. We also have an "onboarding essentials" doc in the Handbook (Onboarding -> Essentials).

Noah Simms: Thanks Alyssa. 2pm EST for the intro works. My GitHub handle is noah-simms.

IT Support (Alex): Hey Noah  welcome aboard. Sent MDM invite to the personal email on your profile (noah.personal@example.com). Laptop shipping scheduled; FedEx tracking will go to your email. For SSH, please generate an ed25519 key and paste the public key into the onboarding form. Example: ```ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "noah@redwood.com"``` If you run into permission issues, `chmod 700 ~/.ssh` and `chmod 600 ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` should fix it.

Noah Simms: Cool, thanks Alex. Do I paste the public key into the web form or attach it?

IT Support (Alex): Paste it into the form text box. If you prefer, DM me the key and I can add it.

Alyssa Chen: Ive added you to the #product-platform channel and invited you to the recurring standups. Also shared a short checklist DM with common first-day tasks and docs to skim.

Onboard Bot: New hire onboarding created for Noah Simms (ID OB-4232105432). Tasks created: MDM invite, Laptop shipment, SSH key, GitHub org invitation, Intro sync, Sandbox access form. Owners: IT Support (Alex), Ben Park, Alyssa Chen.

Ben Park: Welcome Noah :wave: For sandbox access I need the signed infra access form (Google doc). Ill drop the link in the thread after your intro. Once signed, I can provision a sandbox cluster for a couple of weeks.

Noah Simms: Got it. Ill sign after the welcome call. Also: @Alyssa, you in for ukulele at the next retreat? :sunglasses:

Alyssa Chen: Absolutely yes. Cant wait :guitar: 

IT Support (Alex): Ping me here after you paste the pubkey and Ill confirm GitHub invite. If you need to change the shipping address, DM me ASAP.

Noah Simms: Pasted the key and uploaded the form. Thanks everyone for the warm welcome! Looking forward to diving in and maybe annoying you with ukulele practice :grin:

Ben Park: Received the signed form, provisioning sandbox now. You should have access in ~30 minutes.

Alyssa Chen: See you at 2pm EST for the quick intro. Welcome to Redwood Inference, Noah! :rocket:
